# One invoice settled by two payments of different sizes out of one account.
#
# Printed and read into another book, both blocks carry guids that name
# nothing there, so both payments are recorded from their blocks. Editing the
# invoice and reading it again rebuilds it, and the rebuild's unpost marks
# *both* settlements with the same invoice guid — so finding "the settlement
# this record orphaned" has two answers, and each block has to be paired with
# its own.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable
	type: Accounts Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

customer "C-TWICE"
	name: "Twice Paying Customer"
	currency: CAD

invoice "INV-TWICE"
	customer_id: "C-TWICE"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-01
		description: "A line"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-01
		due: 2026-01-31
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "Invoice INV-TWICE"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-01-15
		amount: 60
		account: "Assets:Bank"
		memo: "First instalment"
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-15
		amount: 40
		account: "Assets:Bank"
		memo: "Second instalment"
